task: Multi-Label Social Engineering and Scam Tactic Detection

unavailable_tactics.name: Fake Investment Opportunities
unavailable_tactics.reason: UNAVAILABLE: No verified ground-truth training annotations exist in benchmark dataset. Model not fabricated.

urgency_time_pressure.name: Urgency and Time Pressure
urgency_time_pressure.description: Imposes artificial deadlines or countdowns to panic victims into hasty compliance without verification.

threats_intimidation.name: Threats and Intimidation
threats_intimidation.description: Coerces victims using legal threats, police action, service cutoffs, or physical/financial harm.
threats_intimidation.mapping_source: ScamShield Head 1: fear == 1 OR Head 2 in ['Electricity Disconnection', 'Traffic e-Challan']

otp_credential_requests.name: OTP and Credential Requests
otp_credential_requests.description: Directly solicits one-time passwords (OTPs), PINs, passwords, or authentication tokens.
otp_credential_requests.mapping_source: ScamShield Head 2: 'OTP / Credential Theft' OR metadata: has_otp == True

financial_manipulation.name: Financial Manipulation
financial_manipulation.description: Manipulates victims regarding unauthorized debits, transaction disputes, penalty fees, or loan disbursements.
financial_manipulation.mapping_source: ScamShield Head 1: financial_pressure == 1 OR Head 2: 'Loan Scam'

authority_impersonation.name: Bank or Government Impersonation
authority_impersonation.description: Falsely impersonates trusted financial institutions (SBI, HDFC), regulatory agencies, police, or government departments.
authority_impersonation.mapping_source: ScamShield Head 1: authority_impersonation == 1 OR Head 2 in ['Traffic e-Challan', 'Fake KYC']

fake_employment.name: Fake Employment Opportunities
fake_employment.description: Lures victims with fraudulent work-from-home, part-time rating, YouTube video liking, or Telegram task jobs.

fake_investment.name: Fake Investment Opportunities
fake_investment.description: Promises unrealistic or guaranteed returns on cryptocurrency, forex, or stock market trading schemes.
fake_investment.mapping_source: UNAVAILABLE: No verified ground-truth training annotations exist in benchmark dataset. Model not fabricated.

account_suspension.name: Account Suspension Threats
account_suspension.description: Falsely claims that bank accounts, debit cards, PAN linkages, or SIM cards have been suspended or frozen.
account_suspension.mapping_source: ScamShield Head 2: 'Bank Account Freeze' OR ('Fake KYC' AND Head 1 fear == 1)

prize_reward_scams.name: Prize and Reward Scams
prize_reward_scams.description: Baits victims with unsolicited lottery winnings, cash rewards, free gifts, or prize giveaways.
prize_reward_scams.mapping_source: ScamShield Head 1: reward_bait == 1 OR Head 2: 'Lottery / Prize'

refund_payment_manipulation.name: Refund and Payment Manipulation
refund_payment_manipulation.description: Exploits UPI Collect requests, fake refund processing, or parcel re-delivery payment fees to siphon funds.
